notes: Holding out in first person against waves of hostile AI is the PvE Shooter preset, and the skill's own example treats a zombie shooter you hold out against waves in as Shooter rather than a Survival mix - wave survival here is the mode name, and no Survival feature (shelter, resources, escape) is anywhere in the prompt, so I left the genre list at one. lane-network is both the preset's shape and what the answers describe: a few roads channelling the undead vehicles into predictable engagement fronts around a defended pocket a few hundred studs across, with spawner-npc at the far end of each road and choke-bottleneck where they narrow into the pocket. I considered Strategy's lane-actor-track and rejected it because that is one hard-coded enemy lane to a core defended from outside the fight, which would import a P6 this does not need. Decided without a user: dropped the preset's building-interior since nothing in the prompt goes indoors, which keeps this on P0; the insistence on a true 3D world rules out any P5 reading, and the per-enemy generated vehicle models are asset work rather than layout, so they carry no option here.
